doctrinalCheck.question: Item 3 asserts gate 3 holds for EE-6b, EE-7c and EE-7e, but this entry edits no file-08 cell — the naming exists only as a recorded coordinator decision. Does a no-cell-edit naming satisfy D-056 gate 3's requirement that each remainder be already named at a condition-4 / DR-G* obligation with an owner?
doctrinalCheck.whyIAsked: Every other closure in this chain — D-147, D-157, D-158 — paid for its naming with an MF-6 file-08 write. This one does not, so the question is whether item 3 is claiming standing the act did not buy.
doctrinalCheck.answer: It is sound, on direct precedent. D-145 recorded gate-harness-naming.v6 naming DR-133 NT-1, NT-2 and NT-6 at G21 and NT-4 and NT-7 at G20, and states in its own adopted bytes 'Does not edit file 08.' D-147 then asserted that D-056 Eligibility gates 2 and 3 hold for all seven DR-133 NT classes — five of which had been named by that no-cell-edit decision. So a naming recorded by D-000 decision, without a cell edit, has already been counted for gate 3 in adopted bytes. D-159 stands on the same footing, and the draft's own 'Same no-cell-edit branch as D-145' names that footing correctly.

coordinatorSummary: CONSENT at 0 MUST-FIX and 0 SHOULD-FIX, with no advisories. Fourteen attacks run, none landed. Custody holds: subject c56e55dc at 0444 unmoved, HEAD never left 0fcf3d3, file 08 at 3a9442d1 and COORD at d44f6806 both matching the draft's pins and both unmoved, no D-159 heading, C-D159 unused, D-158 the last adopted entry, and all seven cited files reproduce. Live standing confirms every figure the entry recites: DR-117 still OPEN, 30 gate rows with no DR-G31, condition 4 at 30 of 30 owners and 26 of 26 required, condition 2 at 4 of 32. The recital that matters is item 3, and it is the one v2 was missing: after this recording, D-056 gates 2 and 3 hold for DR-117, on three stated grounds I verified independently at the v3 review — the ten leftover classes named at G29 and G30, EE-3a discharged by named DR-133 classes, and the three riders named at G09, G14 and G16, which together cover all fourteen EE classes with an owner on every owning gate. Gate 1 is correctly held false on D-137's express reservation, which D-137's adopted text does carry, and gates 4 and 5 are stated unperformed. The question worth pressing was whether item 3 buys standing it did not pay for, since this entry edits no file-08 cell while every other closure in this chain paid with an MF-6 write. It does not: D-145 named five DR-133 classes at G20 and G21 and says in its own bytes that it does not edit file 08, and D-147 then counted all seven for gates 2 and 3. The no-cell-edit branch the draft names is the right one. Because silence about downstream standing is the failure I missed twice on this chain, I checked all five D-056 gates rather than the two at issue, and all five plus both conditions are accounted for. One forward note, recorded again rather than charged: D-137 grounded its reservation in most enforcement classes lacking an exact DR-G obligation, and that ground is now cured, so whether the reservation outlives it is the live question for the next act. The entry resolves it conservatively by claiming less, which is why it is not a finding.
